what: A raw percussion synth after the Behringer EDGE / Moog DFAM: one voice with two oscillators, FM, sync, noise and a ladder filter, an 8-step sequencer with a pitch and a velocity knob per step, a clock up to x128 where the rhythm turns into a tone, and the keys as a patchbay: black keys are outputs, white keys inputs, including delay, reverb, master filter and crush. MIDI clock in.
author: swtdr34mz
